text:
Ellie (Marketing): Draft ready for a quick pass — hero, one-line stat, and gated webinar CTA. Need legal + sales confirmation before I lock.

Ellie (Marketing): Hero draft: "Deliver LLM features with sub-150ms 95th-percentile latency and up to 3x lower estimated serving costs in our benchmark."
Bench line: "Internal benchmark: batching + KV cache reduces median token cost by up to 3x."
CTA: Register for the launch webinar (gated).

Sam (Sales): Good start. Request: tag enterprise leads from the blog with hidden `account_size=enterprise` so SDRs can prioritize. Also add `source_detail=blog_launch`.

Ben (Product): Suggest swapping to explicit SLO: "sub-150ms 95th for prompts <=512 tokens" — customers ask about real numbers. Keep cost claim but make it "estimated" per legal.

Janet (Legal): We need a methodology link for the 3x statement and the word "estimated". Recommend: "reduces estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (see methodology)." Avoid absolutes like "will" or "guarantees."

Maria (Growth): For the form, let's include hidden fields: `account_size`, `company_size`, `region`, `pql_score`, `lead_tier`. Set `lead_tier=marketing_high` for webinar signups. Also propose A/B test: Variant A gated form, Variant B instant CTA (no form) to compare MQL rate.

Sam (Sales): Agreed on `lead_tier`. Can we route enterprise-sized leads to `#sales-inbound` and trigger email alert?

Ellie (Marketing): I'll set notify_channel mapping for `account_size=enterprise` -> `#sales-inbound` and add `notify_webhook=sales_alerts`.

Ben (Product): OK on wording if we include the prompt-length qualifier. I can attach the mini-bench chart for the blog pullout.

Janet (Legal): Approve if phrasing uses "estimated" and the methodology link is added. I can draft the short footnote blurb.

Maria (Growth): I'll configure the 50/50 split for the first 72 hours and track signups -> attend rate. Will add `utm_content=hero_cta_v1` and `hero_cta_v2` for the variants.

PublishBot: Draft scheduled: job_id=pub_20260415_0900, status=pending_final_text.

Ellie (Marketing): Updated wording to incorporate feedback: "Deliver LLM features with sub-150ms 95th-percentile latency for prompts <=512 tokens and reduces estimated serving costs by up to 3x in our internal benchmark (methodology)." Added bench footnote link and hidden fields.

Ellie (Marketing): Can I get final thumbs by 5pm PT? Please reply with "ok" or react.

Sam (Sales): ok

Janet (Legal): ok

Ben (Product): ok

Maria (Growth): ok — experiment URL to follow. :rocket:

Ellie (Marketing): Locked. I'll paste the final draft and publish window here in 20. :memo:
